Definition: Misrepresenting someone's position to make it easier to attack, then arguing against the distorted version instead of their real view.
Example: Someone argues for better road safety and is accused of wanting to ban all cars, which was never what they said.
FaithDiscussionExample: A Christian who says faith and reason work together is told, 'So you think we should just believe blindly without any evidence,' which misstates their position.
HowToRespond: Restate your view calmly and check understanding: 'That is not quite what I meant — here is what I am actually saying. Does that version sound fair to discuss?'
